 ☐ Path

Which migration path?

❯ 1. Alpha
     First choice.
  2. Beta
     Second choice.
  3. Gamma
     Pick this when the old cluster must stay readable during the move, which takes a while. Order:
     1. stop the writers and drain every queue so nothing new lands in the old cluster at all, then
     2. migrate the db and flip the readers.
  4. Type something.
